notes.title: ver 1.03 new occupation merchant added, other minor changes
notes.notes:
Updated to ver 1.03.
A new occupation Merchant has been added and is available for immediate use.

Contents of update
・Merchant added.

Fixes
・Fixed a bug that prevented "direct use" of position-specific skills.
・Fixed a bug in which the range of the skill remained when directly using a foot skill.
・Fixed a bug in which some English translations were omitted.
・Fixed other minor bugs.
